svg.text: REFERENCE DEMO H · WIDTH SCHEMATIC · MID-SCROLL
ROOT AND VIEWPORT SHARE THE SAME CLIP.
TRACK OVERLAYS CONTENT; IT RESERVES NO WIDTH.
HATCH = MASK REGION, NOT A VISIBLE SURFACE.
CALLER SIZES AND STYLES THE ROOT.
NO BUILT-IN PADDING, BORDER OR SHADOW.
AXIS BARS MOUNT ONLY WHILE OVERFLOWING.
TOP INSET CAN PRESERVE A PINNED HEADER.
AUTO: HOVER OR SCROLL REVEALS THE BAR.
HIDDEN BAR PASSES POINTER EVENTS THROUGH.
FOCUS OUTLINE IS ON THE UNMASKED ROOT.
ONLY DIRECT-CHILD VIEWPORT FOCUS TRIGGERS IT.
BOTH: CORNER JOINS THE TWO OVERLAY TRACKS.
CONTENT WRAPPER SIZES TO FIT WIDE CHILDREN.
DASH = HIT AREA · GREY = RAIL / THUMB
OUTER EDGE → S2 + W1 + S1 = T1
X / Y MASKS INTERSECT; RTL FLIPS X.
AT AN EDGE: THAT EDGE HAS ZERO FADE.
SHEET IS NOT A SCALE MEASUREMENT.
L1 / P1 CHANGE WITH LIVE CONTENT.
ONE SHEET · SOURCE GEOMETRY / CALLER SCHEMATICS
Z SEPARATION SCHEMATIC · NO SHADOW LAYER
MASK AFFECTS VIEWPORT; OVERLAY BAR STAYS OPAQUE.
